1	# Preference reads
     2	
     3	Python 3.9+, standard library only. Run `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests`.
     4	
     5	This change accepts preference IDs with surrounding whitespace. Trim the ID
     6	before looking it up; preserve the existing resilient-read contract. A logical
     7	read may make up to three attempts on `TransientRead`, returning the first
     8	successful result. Exhausted transient errors propagate. `MissingPreference`
     9	is permanent and must propagate on the first attempt. Reads have no side effects.
    10	
    11	`Preferences.read` is the public entry point. `Repository.read_resilient`
    12	owns the bounded retry policy; `read_once` performs one attempt. The scripted
    13	backend models finite outcomes without sleeping, services or concurrency.
